cards.name: Teysa Karlov
cards.oracleText:
If a creature dying causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
Creature tokens you control have vigilance and lifelink.

cards.name: Teysa, Orzhov Scion
cards.oracleText:
Sacrifice three white creatures: Exile target creature.
Whenever another black creature you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts
cards.oracleText:
Vigilance, protection from creatures
Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, destroy that creature. Create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Teysa, Opulent Oligarch
cards.oracleText:
Deathtouch
At the beginning of your end step, investigate for each opponent who lost life this turn.
Whenever a Clue you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Teysa, Orzhov Scion Avatar
cards.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Teysa of the Ghost Council
cards.oracleText:
Starting intensity 0
When Teysa enters, create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying. Teysa intensifies by 1.
Spirits you control get +X/+0, where X is Teysa's intensity.
At the beginning of your end step, you may exile Teysa. If you do, at the beginning of your next upkeep, return Teysa to the battlefield under its owner's control and it gains haste.
